settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Runtime settings — most take effect immediately, no restart needed.

settingsGeneral.title: General
settingsGeneral.subtitle: Application, localization, network, logging, and linking behavior. Most changes take effect immediately, no restart needed.
settingsGeneral.rootsEmptyErr: Allowed roots must not be empty.
settingsGeneral.saved: Settings saved — linking changes take effect on the next poll.
settingsGeneral.unlinkLabel: Unlink on mismatch (remove links when a rule no longer matches)
settingsGeneral.footnote: <0>skip</0> = never link across filesystems (default) · <1>copy</1> = copy the file · <2>symlink</2> = symlink. Destinations are always jailed to the allowed roots.
settingsGeneral.networkHint: Set via the PORT environment variable or compose file — not editable here, and changing it requires a restart.
settingsGeneral.logSizeLimitHint: Rotating log file under config/logs — applies immediately, no restart needed.

settingsServices.title: Services
settingsServices.subtitle: Connect Radarr and Sonarr — test the connection, import tags, and rescan to reconcile links.
settingsServices.deleteConfirm: Delete service “{{name}}”? Its links will be left in place.

settingsAuth.title: Authentication
settingsAuth.subtitle: Password and OIDC login are independent — enable either or both. Changes apply immediately. A blank secret field keeps the current value; only a new value replaces it (secrets are never returned to the UI).
settingsAuth.saved: Authentication saved — it takes effect immediately, no restart.
settingsAuth.autoLoginHint: Redirect straight to the provider on load; off shows a sign-in button instead.
settingsAuth.allowListHint: Allowed for sign-in: any user whose email is in the email list <0>or</0> whose group is in the group list. Both empty = anyone who can sign in with the provider may use ArrLink.

settingsVocab.title: Vocabulary
settingsVocab.subtitle: Known values per condition category (genre, certification, quality, language, collection), used for autocomplete suggestions and “match anything known” rule conditions. Everything below already refreshes automatically in the background — nothing here is a required setup step.
settingsVocab.tmdbDefaultConfigured: A default TMDB key is configured for this deployment — genre and certification sync works with no setup.
settingsVocab.tmdbNoDefault: No default TMDB key is configured for this deployment. Set your own key below, or ask the operator to configure one via the TMDB_API_KEY environment variable.
settingsVocab.keyUnsetPlaceholder: Optional — uses the default key if left blank
settingsVocab.trashHint: Community-maintained quality-profile naming dictionary — public, no key required.
settingsVocab.trashRefreshed: Refreshed {{count}} {{appType}} quality name(s) from TRaSH Guides.
settingsVocab.instanceHint: Each service's own configured quality profiles and languages, plus collection names seen in its imported items — already refreshed on every poll.

settingsBackup.title: Backup
settingsBackup.subtitle: Nightly database backup with retention, plus a couple of small housekeeping knobs. Backups are stored alongside the app's config directory.
settingsBackup.intervalHoursHint: How often an automatic backup runs.
settingsBackup.retentionDaysHint: Backups older than this are pruned automatically.
settingsBackup.eventsRetentionHint: Maximum rows kept in the activity log before older ones are pruned.

ruleModal.name: Name
ruleModal.presetHint: Applying a preset fills or adds a condition below — adjust anything before saving.
ruleModal.conditionsHintChain: An ordered AND/OR chain, evaluated left to right. Only conditions that actually match contribute their category’s placeholder (e.g. <0>{$genre}</0>) to the destination below.
ruleModal.sourceTagHint: Matches against this service's arbitrary tags, as today.
ruleModal.sourceNativeHint: Matches directly against Radarr/Sonarr's own real metadata for this item — no matching tag required.
ruleModal.vocabularyMatchHint: Matches any of the {{count}} currently known value(s) for this category — no need to pick specific ones.
ruleModal.settingsHint: These settings are applied when the conditions above are met.
ruleModal.selectServiceFirst: Select a specific service above to configure conditions — tag suggestions depend on the service’s type.
